references.provenance: Duolingo official research repository and published ACL paper
references.evidence_level: official README and official repository PDF directly read

excerpts.exact_text: Half-life regression (HLR) is a model for spaced repetition practice, with particular applications to second language acquisition. The model marries psycholinguistic theory with modern machine learning techniques, indirectly estimating the "half-life" of words (and potentially any other item or fact) in a student's long-term memory.
* ``delta`` - time (in seconds) since the last lesson/practice that included this word/lexeme
* ``history_correct`` - total times user has been correct for the word/lexeme prior to this lesson/practice
